name: Migration Validator Connector
description: Enterprise migration validation connector for Migration Validator (AI Data QA Tool). Federates PostgreSQL/MSSQL/Athena source systems with a Snowflake target, performing AI-assisted schema/column mapping, confidence-scored validation plan generation, count/data validation execution, and human-in-the-loop write-back with full audit logging.

skills.name: Discover Connections
skills.description: List all configured source database connections and the Snowflake target.

skills.name: List Databases
skills.description: List databases available on a source connection slot.

skills.name: List Schemas
skills.description: List schemas in a source database.

skills.name: List Tables
skills.description: List tables in a source schema.

skills.name: Get Table Schema
skills.description: Get column metadata for a source table (names and types, not data).

skills.name: Get Table Mapping
skills.description: Return the canonical validation plan summary for a table — status, coverage, warnings.

skills.name: Get Column Mappings
skills.description: Return detailed column-level mappings for a table including confidence scores and approval status.

skills.name: Get Pending Reviews
skills.description: Return all column mappings that require human approval.

skills.name: Get Rule
skills.description: Return the full Rule Book entry for a rule — semantics, SQL transformation, validation strategy.

skills.name: Get Applicable Rules
skills.description: Return rules that apply to a source/target type pair.

skills.name: Get Validation Plan
skills.description: Return the full canonical validation plan for a table.

skills.name: Generate Validation Plan
skills.description: Generate and persist a canonical validation plan for a source-to-Snowflake table pair using AI-assisted column matching.

skills.name: Generate Validation SQL
skills.description: Return metadata about generated SQL validation files for a table.

skills.name: Execute Validation
skills.description: Execute the stored validation plan for a table — runs count and data validation.

skills.name: Get Validation Result
skills.description: Return the most recent validation result for a table.

skills.name: Get Validation Failures
skills.description: Return structured failure analysis for a table — mismatches, likely cause, remediation.

skills.name: Get Migration Summary
skills.description: Return a portfolio health summary across all tables in a layer.

skills.name: Get Coverage
skills.description: Federated coverage query: return all tables in a layer whose validation coverage matches a filter.

skills.name: Get Business Metrics
skills.description: Return aggregated business value metrics — automation rate, failures detected, ROI.

skills.name: Approve Mapping
skills.description: Approve a single pending column mapping. Idempotent: already-approved and auto-accepted mappings return ok. Requires an authenticated human actor; audited.

skills.name: Batch Approve Mappings
skills.description: Approve multiple pending column mappings in a single call. Use after get_pending_reviews when the human has confirmed a batch. Requires an authenticated human actor; each record audited individually.

skills.name: Reject Mapping
skills.description: Reject a pending column mapping with a reason. Requires an authenticated human actor; audited.

skills.name: Modify Mapping
skills.description: Override a pending mapping's target column or transformation rule, then approve it.

skills.name: Approve Rule
skills.description: Activate a learned rule in the Rule Book. Requires an authenticated human actor; audited.

skills.name: Approve Plan
skills.description: Mark a canonical validation plan as human-approved. Records decision in audit log.
